// Housekeeping: what state each room is in right now. An instance is a room.
signal start_cleaning(room: String, staff: String) -> String   // Housekeeping
    // dirty -> cleaning, and records `staff` as the room's cleaner. Returns "cleaning".
writes     cleaners: Map<String, String> [persistent]   // room -> who is (or was last) cleaning it
moves      dirty -> cleaning
machine    upkeep — one instance per id (the String or Int you pass); initial `clean`
               get_status(id) is () until the id's first transition (edition 2026: `clean`) — write `get_status(id) ?? "clean"`
               clean -> occupied   // a guest checks in
               occupied -> dirty   // the guest leaves
               dirty -> cleaning
               cleaning -> clean
               clean -> out_of_order   // blocked for repairs
               out_of_order -> clean
